Short Description:

This project focuses on developing an AutoML pipeline optimization system using Scikit-Learn and Optuna for handling highly imbalanced datasets. The goal is to create a fully automated, hyperparameter-tuned machine learning pipeline that selects the best preprocessing steps, feature selection techniques, and model architectures based on dataset characteristics.

Problem Domain:

  • Automated Machine Learning (AutoML)
  • Class Imbalance Handling
  • Hyperparameter Optimization
  • Feature Selection and Engineering

Use Cases:

  • Fraud Detection (e.g., credit card transactions)
  • Anomaly Detection (e.g., cybersecurity threat detection)
  • Medical Diagnosis (e.g., detecting rare diseases from patient data)
  • Churn Prediction (e.g., predicting customer churn in e-commerce)
  • Defective Product Identification (e.g., manufacturing industry)

Frameworks Used:

  • Scikit-Learn (ML models, preprocessing, evaluation)
  • Optuna (Hyperparameter tuning)
  • Imbalanced-Learn (Class balancing techniques)
  • Pandas & NumPy (Data manipulation)
  • Matplotlib & Seaborn (Visualization)

Python Code:

# Advanced AutoML Pipeline Optimization for Imbalanced Datasets
# File: automl_pipeline_optimization_for_imbalanced_datasets.py
# Author: SE
# Timestamp: 2025-03-26

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import optuna
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, RobustScaler, MinMaxScaler
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score
from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml

# Load Imbalanced Dataset from OpenML (Credit Card Fraud Detection)
dataset: pd.DataFrame = fetch_openml(name="creditcard", version=1, as_frame=True).frame

# Display class distribution
print("Class Distribution:\n", dataset['Class'].value_counts())

# Splitting Data
X: pd.DataFrame = dataset.drop(columns=['Class'])
y: pd.Series = dataset['Class']
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42)

# Define Hyperparameter Optimization Function
def objective(trial: optuna.trial.Trial):
    # Hyperparameters to optimize
    model_name: str = trial.suggest_categorical("model", ["RandomForest", "GradientBoosting", "LogisticRegression"])
    n_features: int = trial.suggest_int("n_features", 5, X_train.shape[1])
    scaler_name: str = trial.suggest_categorical("scaler", ["StandardScaler", "RobustScaler", "MinMaxScaler"])

    # Feature Selection
    selector: SelectKBest = SelectKBest(f_classif, k=n_features)
    X_train_selected: np.ndarray = selector.fit_transform(X_train, y_train)
    X_test_selected: np.ndarray = selector.transform(X_test)

    # Scaling
    if scaler_name == "StandardScaler":
        scaler: StandardScaler = StandardScaler()
    elif scaler_name == "RobustScaler":
        scaler: RobustScaler = RobustScaler()
    else:
        scaler: MinMaxScaler = MinMaxScaler()

    X_train_scaled: np.ndarray = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_selected)
    X_test_scaled: np.ndarray = scaler.transform(X_test_selected)

    # Handling Class Imbalance
    smote: SMOTE = SMOTE(sampling_strategy=0.3, random_state=42)
    X_train_resampled, y_train_resampled = smote.fit_resample(X_train_scaled, y_train)

    # Model Selection
    if model_name == "RandomForest":
        model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=trial.suggest_int("n_estimators", 50, 200), random_state=42)
    elif model_name == "GradientBoosting":
        model = GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=trial.suggest_int("n_estimators", 50, 200), learning_rate=trial.suggest_float("learning_rate", 0.01, 0.3), random_state=42)
    else:
        model = LogisticRegression(C=trial.suggest_float("C", 0.01, 10), max_iter=trial.suggest_int("max_iter", 100, 1000))

    # Cross-validation
    skf: StratifiedKFold = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    score: float = cross_val_score(model, X_train_resampled, y_train_resampled, cv=skf, scoring='roc_auc').mean()

    return score

# Run Hyperparameter Optimization
study: optuna.study.Study = optuna.create_study(direction="maximize")
study.optimize(objective, n_trials=50)

# Best Params
best_params: dict = study.best_params
print("Best Parameters:", best_params)

# Train Best Model
final_model = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=best_params["n_estimators"], random_state=42)
final_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = final_model.predict(X_test)

# Performance Metrics
accuracy: float = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
precision: float = precision_score(y_test, y_pred)
recall: float = recall_score(y_test, y_pred)
f1: float = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)
roc_auc: float = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_pred)

# Display Metrics
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}, Precision: {precision:.4f}, Recall: {recall:.4f}, F1 Score: {f1:.4f}, ROC AUC: {roc_auc:.4f}")
